subject: OrthoMed MAP: activation roles, evaluation plan, and timeline
messages:
From: Aisha Rahman <aisha@redwood.ai>
To: Dr. Elena Ortiz <eortiz@orthomed.com>, Samir Patel <spatel@orthomed.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 21 Aug 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: OrthoMed MAP: activation roles, evaluation plan, and timeline

Hi Elena and Samir —

Congrats again on signing — excited to get OrthoMed into a short evaluation window and set a clear activation timeline. I've attached a first-pass MAP (OrthoMed_MAP_v1.xlsx) that lays out milestones, owners, and success criteria for a 6-week evaluation leading into production pilot. High-level asks below:  

- Week 0 (this week): kickoff call to confirm stakeholders and access (data samples, API credentials).
- Weeks 1–3: ingestion & validation; Redwood to provide trial endpoints and basic integration support.
- Weeks 4–5: evaluation run with sample patient workflows; measure latency, throughput, and end-to-end cost per request.
- Week 6: findings review + decision window (pilot/go/no-go).

Planned internal owners: Vivek (Customer Success) will run onboarding and evaluation operations; Marissa (Onboarding) will coordinate integration tasks and weekly checkpoints. Aisha (me) will remain the deal owner for procurement and scope. 

Could you confirm the two primary stakeholders on your side for clinical validation and IT/network access? Also calling out two quick dependencies for the kickoff: SFTP or API access to the anonymized dataset and a sandbox network IP allowlist (we can provide the IP ranges).

I propose we do a 30-minute kickoff on Monday 24 Aug at 10:00am PT. If that works, I'll send a calendar invite and drop the MAP into a shared Drive folder.

Next steps (if yes): I'll upload SOW draft and a short integration checklist for your IT team.

Best,
Aisha Rahman
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
aisha@redwood.ai | +1 415 555 0123

Attachments: OrthoMed_MAP_v1.xlsx
From: Dr. Elena Ortiz <eortiz@orthomed.com>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samir Patel <spatel@orthomed.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 22 Aug 2026 09:18:00 -0500
Subject: Re: OrthoMed MAP: activation roles, evaluation plan, and timeline

Hi Aisha —

Thanks — this looks reasonable and clear. Quick answers from my side:
- Clinical lead: Dr. Marcus Lin (marcus.lin@orthomed.com) will own evaluation of model outputs and clinical criteria.
- IT lead for access: Priya Sethi (priya.sethi@orthomed.com) will coordinate credentials and allowlisting.

A few clarifying questions before the kickoff:
1) For the evaluation success criteria, can you add a short section on the metrics you'll track (e.g., precision/recall on classification labels, acceptable latency thresholds under 500ms for 95th percentile)?
2) We need to understand what data we must share exactly — is a sample of 2k deidentified records sufficient to start?
3) Procurement: Samir is copied — our purchasing team will likely request SOW + order form and a redline window of 5 business days.

We are available Mon 24 Aug at 10:00am PT for the kickoff. Please send calendar invite and the Drive link.

Regards,
Elena Ortiz, MD
Chief Clinical Officer | OrthoMed Solutions
eortiz@orthomed.com | +1 617 555 9090
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
To: Dr. Elena Ortiz <eortiz@orthomed.com>, Samir Patel <spatel@orthomed.com>, Aisha Rahman <aisha@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 09:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: OrthoMed MAP: activation roles, evaluation plan, and timeline

Thanks Elena — quick follow-up from CS perspective.

On Sat, Aug 22, 2026 at 09:18 AM -0500, Dr. Elena Ortiz wrote:
> Thanks — this looks reasonable and clear. Quick answers from my side:
> - Clinical lead: Dr. Marcus Lin (marcus.lin@orthomed.com) will own evaluation of model outputs and clinical criteria.
> - IT lead for access: Priya Sethi (priya.sethi@orthomed.com) will coordinate credentials and allowlisting.

I'll take the lead on weekly checkpoints, evaluation orchestration, and the runbook for the trial. A few things my team will prepare ahead of the kickoff:
- A short measurement plan that maps your clinical criteria to specific eval tests (we'll include precision/recall and qualitative triage checks).
- A list of required fields and a small ingestion script (Python) to validate the 2k deidentified records — 2k is fine as a starting point.
- A 30-minute onboarding runbook for your IT team that covers IP allowlist, token lifecycle, and data retention settings.

Proposed kickoff agenda (30m):
1) Intros & objectives (5m)
2) Roles & access plan (5m)
3) Data & measurement checklist (10m)
4) Timeline & next steps (10m)

I uploaded the MAP to our shared folder and added a short trial instructions PDF: https://drive.redwood.ai/shared/OrthoMed_MAP_v1
HubSpot record for visibility: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/company/ORT-789

See you all at 10:00am PT.

—Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Director, Customer Success | Redwood Inference
vivek@redwood.ai
From: Samir Patel <spatel@orthomed.com>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>, Dr. Elena Ortiz <eortiz@orthomed.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: OrthoMed MAP: activation roles, evaluation plan, and timeline

Aisha/Vivek —

We're on for 10:00am PT. A couple procurement items to flag so we can keep to the timeline:
- Our finance team requests a draft SOW + order form before signing. Can you share the SOW_OrthoMed_draft.docx and an estimated billing contact?
- We generally run a 5 business day turnaround on redlines — if we can get the SOW today it will keep us on track for a Sept 1 pilot start.

Action items I will cover on our side: assign legal reviewer (I've CC'd Priya Sethi for IT but she'll not be the legal contact) and confirm budget owner.

Thanks — Samir
Samir Patel
Procurement Lead | OrthoMed Solutions
spatel@orthomed.com | +1 312 555 3333

On Mon, Aug 24, 2026 at 09:07 AM -0700, Vivek Kulkarni wrote:
> I'll take the lead on weekly checkpoints, evaluation orchestration, and the runbook for the trial.

Aisha — I can prepare the short onboarding runbook and share the trial instructions PDF (placed in Drive). I'll also confirm which Redwood engineer will join the kickoff for the ingestion checklist.

Attachments: SOW_OrthoMed_draft.docx, Redwood_Trial_Instructions.pdf
